description:
Cancel a bounty. Only the poster can call this, and only while status is 'open' or 'judging' (i.e. before any submission has been accepted).

Signs with BIP-322 over: "AIBTC Bounty Cancel | {bountyId} | {signedAt}"

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: bounty_cancel
